title: Ride wasn’t difficult but...
text: Ride wasn’t difficult but it was a little long. We stopped quite a few places for a short time. Guide was very knowledgeable and pleasant to ask questions to. I enjoyed seeing a lot in a short amount of time and at this price. I recommend it!
author: Janice_P

title: A Bikes = A Class
text:
My husband & I were the only ones booked on the time slot , but that was not a problem . Octavio & Andres took care of us very well . It was a bit daunting for me as I hadn't ridden a bike since Nov 2022 due to a cycle accident & breaking my arm . I have to say Andres reasurred  me through the trip .
Octavio  is so passionate about the history of Barcelona & the city , you cannot help to be enthralled with his conversation . He takes you to some of the highlights of Barcelona .If you have any questions he can answer them with great knowledge .
The trip lasted about 3 hours which was just right
author: janettew390
